title_en: Modeling Spectral Energy Shifts in Spatio-Temporal Graph Anomaly Detection
title_zh: 对时空图异常检测中的谱能量偏移建模

sentences.en: Graph anomaly detection methods aim to distinguish anomalous nodes.
sentences.zh: 图异常检测方法旨在区分异常节点。

sentences.en: While prior methods characterize anomalies through increased variation in the spectral energy distributions, they overlook those that result in decreased variation, i.e., camouflaged anomalies that appear normal.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的方法通过谱能量分布中变异的增加来刻画异常，但它们忽视了那些导致变异减少的异常，即看起来正常的伪装异常。

sentences.en: We show that this type of anomaly persists across multiple datasets and remains undetectable by existing spectral approaches.
sentences.zh: 我们证明这类异常在多个数据集中持续存在，且仍无法被现有的谱方法检测到。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose a node-level spectral energy formulation that is fully compatible with message passing and enables the detection of camouflaged anomalies.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出了一种与消息传递完全兼容的节点级谱能量公式，能够检测伪装异常。

sentences.en: Building on this formulation, we introduce an energy-aware graph learning framework that models spectral shifts through energy-driven message passing in both static and time-series graphs.
sentences.zh: 基于这一公式，我们引入了一个能量感知的图学习框架，通过在静态图和时间序列图上的能量驱动消息传递来建模谱偏移。

sentences.en: Besides, our unified architecture extends to temporal settings without introducing specialized sequence modules, enabling efficient learning under long sliding windows.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的统一架构在无需引入专门序列模块的情况下扩展到时间设置，从而能够在长滑动窗口下进行高效学习。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our approach.
sentences.zh: 在大规模基准上的大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性与可扩展性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/AICPS-Lab/Spectral-Energy-Shifts-in-GAD.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/AICPS-Lab/Spectral-Energy-Shifts-in-GAD 获取。

title_en: Modeling Temporal scRNA-seq Data with Latent Gaussian Process and Optimal Transport
title_zh: 使用潜在高斯过程与最优传输对时间序列 scRNA-seq 数据建模

sentences.en: Single-cell RNA sequencing provides insights into gene expression at single-cell resolution, yet inferring temporal processes from these static snapshot measurements remains a fundamental challenge.
sentences.zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序在单细胞分辨率下提供基因表达洞见，但从这些静态快照测量中推断时间过程仍然是一个根本性挑战。

sentences.en: Current approaches utilizing neural differential equations and flows are sensitive to overfitting and lack careful considerations of biological variability.
sentences.zh: 利用神经微分方程和流的方法对过拟合较为敏感，并且缺乏对生物变异性的仔细考虑。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a generative framework that models population trends using a latent heteroscedastic Gaussian process (GP) approximated by Hilbert space methods.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一个生成式框架，使用由 Hilbert 空间方法近似的潜在异方差高斯过程（GP）来建模群体趋势。

sentences.en: To address the absence of genuine cell trajectories, we leverage an optimal transport (OT) objective that aligns generated and observed population distributions.
sentences.zh: 为解决缺乏真实细胞轨迹的问题，我们利用最优传输（OT）目标，使生成与观测的群体分布对齐。

sentences.en: Our method explicitly captures biological heterogeneity by incorporating cell-specific latent time and cell type conditioning to disentangle temporal asynchrony and trajectories to different cell types.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过纳入细胞特定的潜在时间和细胞类型条件来显式捕获生物异质性，从而解开时间异步性以及通向不同细胞类型的轨迹。

sentences.en: We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on complex interpolation and extrapolation benchmarks and introduce a novel gradient-based strategy for inferring perturbation trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们在复杂的插值和外推基准上展示了最先进的性能，并引入了一种新颖的基于梯度的策略来推断扰动轨迹。

title_en: Modelling Attention with Aitchison Geometry: Token Distinguishability and Temperature Scaling
title_zh: 用 Aitchison 几何为注意力建模：token 可区分性与温度缩放

sentences.en: The attention mechanism with softmax normalisation is a foundational component of  Transformer-based large language models.
sentences.zh: 带 softmax 归一化的注意力机制是基于 Transformer 的大语言模型的基础组件。

sentences.en: However, with very long contexts, attention scores are known to diminish, raising fundamental questions about token distinguishability and how it can be preserved.
sentences.zh: 然而，在非常长的上下文下，注意力分数已知会逐渐减小，这引发了对 token 可区分性及其如何得以保持的根本性问题。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide a formal characterisation of token distinguishability in attention as a function of context length and embedding dimension.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提供了注意力中 token 可区分性关于上下文长度与嵌入维度的形式化刻画。

sentences.en: We introduce Aitchison distance to quantify relative differences among attention probabilities, and show that, with Gaussian queries and keys, even in the long-context regime, token distinguishability converges to a finite, non-zero limit rather than vanishing.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 Aitchison 距离来量化注意力概率之间的相对差异，并证明在查询和键为高斯分布时，即使在长上下文情境下，token 可区分性也会收敛到一个有限、非零的极限而非消失。

sentences.en: Leveraging the linear relationship between inverse-temperature scaling and Aitchison distance, we derive a theoretical lower bound of $\Omega(\sqrt{\log L})$ on the logit scaling required to produce a sharp attention distribution.
sentences.zh: 利用逆温度缩放与 Aitchison 距离之间的线性关系，我们推导出产生尖锐注意力分布所需 logit 缩放的理论下界为 $\Omega(\sqrt{\log L})$。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate that Aitchison distance provides a principled and practical alternative to entropy for monitoring training and inference, as it captures the full compositional structure, including the smaller components of the attention probabilities.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们证明 Aitchison 距离为监控训练与推理提供了熵的一种原则性且实用的替代，因为它捕获了包括注意力概率较小分量在内的完整组成结构。

title_en: Models Under SCOPE: Scalable and Controllable Routing via Pre-hoc Reasoning
title_zh: SCOPE 下的模型：通过前置推理实现可扩展、可控的路由

sentences.en: Model routing chooses which language model to use for each query.
sentences.zh: 模型路由选择为每个查询使用哪个语言模型。

sentences.en: By sending easy queries to cheaper models and hard queries to stronger ones, it can significantly reduce inference cost while maintaining high accuracy.
sentences.zh: 通过将简单查询发送给较便宜的模型、将困难查询发送给较强的模型，它可以显著降低推理成本，同时保持高准确率。

sentences.en: However, most existing routers treat this as a fixed choice among a small set of models, which makes them hard to adapt to new models or changing budget constraints.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有路由器将这一选择视为小规模模型集合中的固定选择，这使得它们难以适配新模型或变化的预算约束。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose SCOPE (Scalable and Controllable Outcome Performance Estimator), a routing framework that goes beyond model selection by predicting their cost and performance.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 SCOPE（可扩展可控结果性能估计器），一个通过预测模型的成本与性能来超越模型选择的路由框架。

sentences.en: Trained with reinforcement learning, SCOPE makes reasoning-based predictions by retrieving how models behave on similar problems, rather than relying on fixed model names, enabling it to work with new, unseen models.
sentences.zh: SCOPE 通过强化学习训练，通过检索模型在类似问题上的表现来做基于推理的预测，而非依赖固定的模型名称，从而能够处理新的、未见过的模型。

sentences.en: Moreover, by explicitly predicting how accurate and how expensive a model will be, it turns routing into a dynamic decision problem, allowing users to easily control the trade-off between accuracy and cost.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过显式预测模型将有多准确、多昂贵，它将路由转化为一个动态决策问题，使用户能够轻松控制准确率与成本之间的权衡。

sentences.en: Experiments show that SCOPE is more than just a cost-saving tool.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，SCOPE 不仅仅是一个节省成本的工具。

sentences.en: It flexibly adapts to user needs: it can boost accuracy by up to **25.7\%** when performance is the priority, or cut costs by up to **95.1\%** when efficiency matters most.
sentences.zh: 它灵活地适应用户需求：当性能优先时，可将准确率提升高达 **25.7\%**；当效率最为重要时，可将成本削减高达 **95.1\%**。

sentences.en: We release the dataset and code at our project page: https://sullivan07043.github.io/SCOPE/.
sentences.zh: 我们在项目页面发布了数据集和代码：https://sullivan07043.github.io/SCOPE/。

title_en: ModernVBERT: Towards Smaller Visual Document Retrievers
title_zh: ModernVBERT：迈向更小的视觉文档检索器

sentences.en: Large-scale document retrieval (search) is key in many modern industrial AI pipelines to ground models with relevant contextual information.
sentences.zh: 大规模文档检索（搜索）是许多现代工业 AI 流水线中的关键环节，用于以相关上下文信息为基础来锚定模型。

sentences.en: Increasingly, Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) models, which directly embed images of document pages, are used as an alternative to text-only retrievers.
sentences.zh: 越来越多地，视觉文档检索（VDR）模型——它直接嵌入文档页面的图像——被用作纯文本检索器的替代方案。

sentences.en: While these models are historically repurposed generative VLMs fine-tuned for embedding tasks, we revisit this design choice in this paper and systematically develop strong VDR models from the ground up.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些模型历史上是重新利用的、为嵌入任务微调的生成式 VLM，但我们在本文中重新审视了这一设计选择，并从零开始系统地构建强大的 VDR 模型。

sentences.en: Through controlled experiments, we isolate the impact of key training factors such as attention masking, multi-modal data regimes, and contrastive objectives at all phases of training.
sentences.zh: 通过受控实验，我们隔离了注意力掩码、多模态数据机制和对比目标等关键训练因素在训练各个阶段的影响。

sentences.en: Our findings confirm current VDR performance is constrained by generative modeling, especially in multi-vector settings.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现证实，当前的 VDR 性能受限于生成式建模，尤其是在多向量设置下。

sentences.en: Building on these insights, we train ModernVBERT, a 250M-parameter vision-language encoder that outperforms recent models up to 10 times its size when fine-tuned on document retrieval tasks.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞察，我们训练了 ModernVBERT，一个 250M 参数的视觉-语言编码器，在文档检索任务上微调后，其表现优于规模高达其 10 倍的近期模型。

sentences.en: Thanks to its compact design, ModernVBERT enables efficient retrieval inference on CPU hardware, while maintaining competitive performance.
sentences.zh: 得益于其紧凑的设计，ModernVBERT 能够在 CPU 硬件上进行高效检索推理，同时保持有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: Models, code and data are available at https://huggingface.co/ModernVBERT.
sentences.zh: 模型、代码和数据可在 https://huggingface.co/ModernVBERT 获取。

title_en: Modular Pretraining Enables Access Control
title_zh: 模块化预训练实现访问控制

sentences.en: AI developers face a dual-use dilemma.
sentences.zh: AI 开发者面临一个双用途困境。

sentences.en: The same capability that helps one user cure a disease can help another synthesize one.
sentences.zh: 同一种能力，帮助一位用户治愈疾病，也可能帮助另一位用户合成疾病。

sentences.en: This dilemma could be resolved by access control, granting different users access to different AI capabilities.
sentences.zh: 这一困境可以通过访问控制来解决，即为不同用户授予对不同 AI 能力的访问权限。

sentences.en: A gold standard for access control would be to serve models with different capabilities to different users.
sentences.zh: 访问控制的黄金标准是向不同用户提供具有不同能力的模型。

sentences.en: However, training and deploying multiple models is prohibitively expensive.
sentences.zh: 然而，训练和部署多个模型的成本高得令人望而却步。

sentences.en: We address this challenge by developing gradient-routed mixture-of-experts (GR-MoE), a pretraining method that selectively updates experts to induce specialization.
sentences.zh: 我们通过开发梯度路由的专家混合（GR-MoE）来应对这一挑战，这是一种选择性更新专家以诱发专业化的预训练方法。

sentences.en: Ablating an expert at inference time removes its capability, approximating a model trained on filtered data.
sentences.zh: 在推理时消融某个专家即可移除其能力，近似于一个在过滤数据上训练的模型。

sentences.en: We evaluate GR-MoE on synthetic stories and realistic dual-use data spanning biology, cybersecurity, nuclear physics, and code.
sentences.zh: 我们在合成故事以及涵盖生物学、网络安全、核物理和代码的现实双用途数据上评估 GR-MoE。

sentences.en: On realistic data, GR-MoE preserves performance on retained capabilities while achieving 30% compute efficiency on forget capabilities.
sentences.zh: 在现实数据上，GR-MoE 保持了保留能力上的性能，同时在被遗忘能力上实现了 30% 的计算效率。

sentences.en: GR-MoE limits recovery more effectively than post-hoc unlearning and preserves capabilities better than LoRA.
sentences.zh: GR-MoE 比事后遗忘更有效地限制了能力的恢复，并且比 LoRA 更好地保留了能力。

sentences.en: GR-MoE's advantages improve when scaled from 48M to 2B parameters, approaching multiple data filtered models in a single training run.
sentences.zh: 当 GR-MoE 的参数规模从 48M 扩展到 2B 时，其优势进一步提升，在单次训练运行中逼近多个数据过滤模型。

title_en: MODUS: Decoder-only Any-to-Any Modeling of Diverse Modalities
title_zh: MODUS：对多样化模态的仅解码器任意到任意建模

sentences.en: Any-to-any modeling aims to flexibly relate arbitrary modalities within a single system, a requirement that arises across multimodal learning and scientific domains such as ecology and astronomy.
sentences.zh: 任意到任意建模旨在在单个系统内灵活关联任意模态，这是多模态学习以及生态学、天文学等科学领域都会产生的需求。

sentences.en: However, existing any-to-any approaches are typically trained from scratch using encoder–decoder or diffusion architectures, limiting empirical performance and the use of pretrained models.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有任意到任意方法通常使用编码器-解码器或扩散架构从零开始训练，限制了对预训练模型的实证表现和利用。

sentences.en: We investigate decoder-only any-to-any multimodal modeling, which treats all modalities symmetrically and supports arbitrary modalities as inputs and outputs without modality-specific heads, losses, or task pipelines.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了仅解码器的任意到任意多模态建模，它对称地对待所有模态，并在无需模态特定头、损失或任务流水线的情况下支持任意模态作为输入和输出。

sentences.en: As a consequence of this unified design, the resulting model MODUS naturally enables chained generation through intermediate modalities, cross-modal consistency verification, and analysis of visual representations by combining semantic and reconstruction features.
sentences.zh: 作为这一统一设计的自然结果，所得到的模型 MODUS 天然地实现了通过中间模态的链式生成、跨模态一致性验证，以及通过结合语义与重构特征对视觉表示进行分析。

sentences.en: Across a range of benchmarks, MODUS demonstrates strong out-of-the-box performance and flexible multimodal composition within a single model.
sentences.zh: 在一系列基准上，MODUS 展现了强大的开箱即用性能，以及单个模型内灵活的多模态组合。

title_en: MOES-Pred: Molecular Structural Representation Learning by  Adaptive Energy-Sentinel Vibration for Generalized Property Prediction
title_zh: MOES-Pred：通过自适应能量哨兵振动实现面向通用性质预测的分子结构表示学习

sentences.en: Predicting molecular properties from three-dimensional structures is fundamentally hindered by limited labeled data.
sentences.zh: 从三维结构预测分子性质从根本上受到有限标注数据的影响。

sentences.en: While researchers have adapted self-supervised pre-training techniques from computer vision and natural language processing to address this scarcity, these approaches frequently neglect the intrinsic physical principles unique to molecular systems.
sentences.zh: 虽然研究者从计算机视觉和自然语言处理中借鉴了自监督预训练技术来应对这种数据稀缺，但这些方法常常忽视了分子系统独有的内在物理原理。

sentences.en: From a physical perspective, denoising pre-training can be formally proven equivalent to learning molecular force fields.
sentences.zh: 从物理角度看，去噪预训练可以被形式化地证明等价于学习分子力场。

sentences.en: However, existing methods indiscriminately apply uniform noise across all molecules, thereby introducing systematic bias into the modeling of molecular distributions.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法不加区分地对所有分子施加统一的噪声，从而在分子分布建模中引入了系统性偏差。

sentences.en: To mitigate this issue, we introduce MOES-Pred, a denoising pre-training framework featuring an energy sentinel mechanism that dynamically tailors noise perturbations to individual molecules.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们引入了 MOES-Pred，一个含能量哨兵机制的去噪预训练框架，该机制动态地针对单个分子定制噪声扰动。

sentences.en: Leveraging chemical prior knowledge, our molecule-specific noising strategies enhance conformational sampling coverage and improve distribution modeling fidelity.
sentences.zh: 借助化学先验知识，我们的分子特定加噪策略增强了构象采样覆盖，并提升了分布建模的保真度。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that MOES-Pred surpasses mainstream approaches in both force prediction and downstream quantum chemical property prediction, demonstrating substantial improvements.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，MOES-Pred 在力预测和下游量子化学性质预测方面都超越了主流方法，展现出显著的改进。

title_en: MoFO: Momentum-Filtered Optimizer for Mitigating Forgetting in LLM Fine-Tuning
title_zh: MoFO：用于缓解 LLM 微调中遗忘的动量过滤优化器

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在广泛的任务上展现了卓越的能力。

sentences.en: Typically, LLMs are first pre-trained on large corpora and subsequently fine-tuned on task-specific datasets.
sentences.zh: 通常，LLMs 首先在大规模语料上进行预训练，随后在任务特定数据集上进行微调。

sentences.en: However, during fine-tuning, LLMs may forget some knowledge acquired in the pre-training stage, leading to a decline in general capabilities.
sentences.zh: 然而，在微调期间，LLMs 可能会遗忘在预训练阶段获得的部分知识，从而导致通用能力的下降。

sentences.en: Existing approaches to mitigate forgetting often rely on access to pre-training data, which may be unavailable in many real-world scenarios—such as fine-tuning checkpoint-only open-source LLMs.
sentences.zh: 现有缓解遗忘的方法常常依赖对预训练数据的访问，而在许多现实场景中（例如对仅含检查点的开源 LLM 进行微调）这些数据可能不可用。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose a new fine-tuning algorithm termed Momentum-Filtered Optimizer (MoFO).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新的微调算法，称为动量过滤优化器（MoFO）。

sentences.en: MoFO is an extension of greedy block coordinate descent (BCD) methods: in each iteration, MoFO only updates the model parameters with the largest momentum magnitudes, while keeping all other parameters fixed.
sentences.zh: MoFO 是贪婪块坐标下降（BCD）方法的扩展：在每次迭代中，MoFO 仅更新具有最大动量幅度的模型参数，而保持所有其他参数不变。

sentences.en: MoFO achieves similar fine-tuning performance to the default fine-tuning algorithm while effectively mitigating knowledge forgetting.
sentences.zh: MoFO 在实现与默认微调算法相当的微调性能的同时，有效缓解了知识遗忘。

sentences.en: We validate MoFO through rigorous convergence analysis and extensive experiments, demonstrating its effectiveness in mitigating forgetting without pre-training data.
sentences.zh: 我们通过严格的收敛性分析和大量实验验证了 MoFO，证明了它在无需预训练数据的情况下缓解遗忘的有效性。

title_en: MolAlign3D: Enhancing Fixed-Dimensional E(3)-Equivariant Latent Space for High-Fidelity 3D Molecular Reconstruction and Editing
title_zh: MolAlign3D：增强固定维 E(3)-等变潜在空间以实现高保真 3D 分子重建与编辑

sentences.en: Recent advances in 3D molecular modeling have achieved high-fidelity structural synthesis, yet these models often lack an explicit and manipulable representation space.
sentences.zh: 三维分子建模领域的最新进展实现了高保真结构合成，但这些模型往往缺乏一个显式且可操作的表示空间。

sentences.en: To address this, MolFLAE introduced a fixed-dimensional, E(3)-equivariant latent space, providing a novel framework for molecular editing independent of atom counts.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，MolFLAE 引入了固定维 E(3)-等变潜在空间，为独立于原子数的分子编辑提供了一种新颖框架。

sentences.en: However, because its latent space was primarily optimized for geometric reconstruction, it remains semantically shallow and inadequate for comprehensive representation learning.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于其潜在空间主要针对几何重建进行优化，它在语义上仍然很浅，不足以进行全面的表示学习。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose **MolAlign3D**, which evolves this architecture into a unified semantic-generative engine.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 **MolAlign3D**，它将这一架构演进为统一的语义-生成引擎。

sentences.en: By anchoring MolFLAE’s manipulable latents with embeddings from a pre-trained molecular encoder, we yield a manifold that is both semantically dense and geometrically precise.
sentences.zh: 通过将 MolFLAE 的可操作潜在表示与预训练分子编码器的嵌入相对齐，我们得到了一个既语义密集又几何精确的流形。

sentences.en: Experiments show that MolAlign3D achieves high-fidelity molecular reconstruction and attains comparable performance on molecular property prediction benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，MolAlign3D 实现了高保真分子重建，并在分子性质预测基准上取得了相当的性能。

sentences.en: Notably, the integration of rich semantic priors significantly enhances zero-shot molecular manipulation, including atom-number editing and latent-space interpolation, outperforming prior fixed-dimensional equivariant latent baseline.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，丰富语义先验的整合显著增强了零样本分子操作，包括原子数编辑和潜在空间插值，超越了先前的固定维等变潜在基线。

title_en: MoLF: Mixture-of-Latent-Flow for Pan-Cancer Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histology
title_zh: MoLF：面向基于组织学的泛癌空间基因表达预测的潜在流混合

sentences.en: Inferring spatial transcriptomics (ST) from histology enables scalable histogenomic profiling, yet current methods are largely restricted to single-tissue models.
sentences.zh: 从组织学推断空间转录组（ST）能够实现可扩展的组织基因组分析，然而当前方法在很大程度上局限于单一组织模型。

sentences.en: This fragmentation fails to leverage biological principles shared across cancer types and hinders application to data-scarce scenarios.
sentences.zh: 这种碎片化无法利用跨癌种共有的生物学原理，也阻碍了其在数据稀缺场景中的应用。

sentences.en: While pan-cancer training offers a solution, the resulting heterogeneity challenges monolithic architectures.
sentences.zh: 虽然泛癌训练提供了一种解决方案，但由此产生的异质性对整体式架构构成了挑战。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce **MoLF** (*Mixture-of-Latent-Flow*), a generative model for pan-cancer histogenomic prediction.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入了 **MoLF**（*Mixture-of-Latent-Flow*，潜在流混合），一个面向泛癌组织基因组预测的生成模型。

sentences.en: MoLF leverages a conditional Flow Matching objective to map noise to the gene latent manifold, parameterized by a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) velocity field.
sentences.zh: MoLF 利用条件流匹配目标将噪声映射到基因潜在流形上，该流形由专家混合（MoE）速度场参数化。

sentences.en: By dynamically routing inputs to specialized sub-networks, this architecture effectively decouples the optimization of diverse tissue patterns.
sentences.zh: 通过将输入动态路由到专门的子网络，这种架构有效解耦了多样化组织模式的优化。

sentences.en: Our experiments demonstrate that MoLF establishes a new state-of-the-art, consistently outperforming both specialized and foundation model baselines on pan-cancer benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，MoLF 确立了新的最先进水平，在泛癌基准上一致优于专门的与基础模型基线。

sentences.en: Furthermore, MoLF exhibits zero-shot generalization to cross-species data, suggesting it captures fundamental, conserved histo-molecular mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 此外，MoLF 展现出对跨物种数据的零样本泛化能力，表明它捕获了根本的、保守的组织-分子机制。

title_en: MoLoRA: Composable Specialization via Per-Token Adapter Routing
title_zh: MoLoRA：通过逐 token 适配器路由实现可组合的专业化

sentences.en: Multi-adapter serving systems route entire sequences to a single adapter, forcing a choice when requests span multiple domains.
sentences.zh: 多适配器服务系统将整个序列路由到单一适配器，当请求跨越多个领域时就不得不做出选择。

sentences.en: This assumption fails in two important settings: (1) multimodal generation, where text and image tokens require different adapters within the same sequence, and (2) mixed-capability requests like ``write code to solve this equation,'' which need expertise from multiple specialized adapters.
sentences.zh: 这一假设在两种重要设置下都会失效：（1）多模态生成，其中文本和图像 token 在同一序列内需要不同的适配器；（2）混合能力请求，如"编写代码求解此方程"，这需要多个专门适配器的专长。

sentences.en: We introduce \emph{per-token routing}, which routes individual tokens to adapters based on either vocabulary structure (for multimodal models) or learned gating (for semantic specialization).
sentences.zh: 我们引入了\emph{per-token routing}（逐 token 路由），它根据词汇结构（针对多模态模型）或学习到的门控（针对语义专业化），将单个 token 路由到适配器。

sentences.en: Per-token routing is provably optimal for mixed-adapter requests: $N$ work for $N$ tokens, versus $K \cdot N$ for per-sequence systems that must replay one adapter per pass.
sentences.zh: 对于混合适配器请求，逐 token 路由被证明是最优的：N 个 token 只需 N 次计算，而逐序列系统为每次通过必须重放一个适配器，需要 K \cdot N 次计算。

sentences.en: Our key contribution is MoLoRA (Mixture of LoRA), which enables \emph{composable specialization}: load multiple domain-specific adapters and let a learned router select the appropriate adapter per-token.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键贡献是 MoLoRA（LoRA 混合），它实现了\emph{composable specialization}（可组合专业化）：加载多个领域特定适配器，并让一个学习到的路由器为每个 token 选择合适的适配器。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that specialization dramatically beats scale: MoLoRA enables Qwen3-1.7B to exceed Qwen3-8B across four reasoning benchmarks while being 4.7$\times$ smaller.
sentences.zh: 我们证明专业化大幅胜过规模：MoLoRA 使 Qwen3-1.7B 在四个推理基准上超越 Qwen3-8B，而规模却小 4.7\times 倍。

sentences.en: This enables modular expertise at inference time: train focused LoRAs independently, combine them without retraining, and add new capabilities by simply loading new adapters.
sentences.zh: 这能够在推理时实现模块化专长：独立训练聚焦的 LoRA，无需重新训练即可组合它们，并通过简单地加载新适配器来添加新能力。

title_en: Moment Matching Q-Learning
title_zh: 矩匹配 Q 学习

sentences.en: Score-based and flow-based generative models exhibit remarkable expressive capacity in capturing complex distributions, and have been extensively deployed in tasks ranging from image generation to reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 基于分数的和基于流的生成模型在捕获复杂分布方面展现出卓越的表达能力，并已被广泛部署在从图像生成到强化学习的各种任务中。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, these models suffer from prolonged inference latency, which imposes a significant computational bottleneck in RL with iterative sampling.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些模型存在推理延迟较长的问题，这在需要迭代采样的 RL 中造成了显著的计算瓶颈。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose a new framework named *Moment Matching Q-Learning* (MoMa QL), which utilizes a technique from statistical hypothesis testing known as maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) that intend to match all orders of statistics between the original and target distribution.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出了一个名为*矩匹配 Q 学习*（MoMa QL）的新框架，它利用了统计假设检验中称为最大均值差异（MMD）的技术，旨在匹配原始分布与目标分布之间的所有阶统计量。

sentences.en: By enforcing strong regularization on all moment statistics, this algorithm guarantees distribution-level convergence for conditional score function and remains stable under various hyperparameters.
sentences.zh: 通过对所有矩统计量施加强正则化，该算法保证了条件分数函数的分布级收敛，并在各种超参数下保持稳定。

sentences.en: Empirically, we show that our method MoMa QL is more computationally efficient with a comparable if not competitive performance in various D4RL tasks.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，我们表明我们的方法 MoMa QL 在各种 D4RL 任务上计算效率更高，性能相当甚至更具竞争力。

sentences.en: Remarkably, by accelerating the action sampling process for flow-based policies, MoMa QL demonstrates superior performance in offline-to-online RL tasks because of faster and stronger adaptability for online interactive finetuning.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，通过加速基于流的策略的动作采样过程，MoMa QL 在离线到在线 RL 任务中展现出优越的性能，这是因为其对在线交互微调的适应更快、更强。

title_en: Momentum Further Constrains Sharpness at the Edge of Stochastic Stability
title_zh: 在随机稳定性边缘，动量进一步约束锐度

sentences.en: Recent work suggests that (stochastic) gradient descent self-organizes near the instability boundary, shaping both optimization and the solutions found.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，（随机）梯度下降会在不稳定边界附近自组织，同时塑造了优化过程与所发现的解。

sentences.en: Momentum and mini-batch gradients are widely used in practical deep learning optimization, but it remains unclear whether they operate in a comparable regime of instability.
sentences.zh: 动量和mini-batch梯度被广泛用于实际的深度学习优化中，但尚不清楚它们是否在可比较的不稳定机制下运行。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that SGD with momentum exhibits an Edge of Stochastic Stability (EoSS)-like regime with \textit{batch-size--dependent behavior} that cannot be explained by a single momentum-adjusted stability threshold.
sentences.zh: 我们证明带动量的 SGD 表现出类似随机稳定性边缘（EoSS）的机制，并具有\textit{batch-size--dependent behavior}（依赖批大小的行为），这无法用单一的动量调整稳定性阈值来解释。

sentences.en: Batch Sharpness (the expected directional mini-batch curvature) stabilizes in two distinct regimes: at small batch sizes it converges to a lower plateau $2(1-\beta)/\eta$, reflecting amplification of stochastic fluctuations by momentum and favoring flatter regions than vanilla SGD; at large batch sizes it converges to a higher plateau $2(1+\beta)/\eta$, where momentum recovers its classical stabilizing effect and favors sharper regions consistent with full-batch dynamics.
sentences.zh: 批量锐度（期望的方向性 mini-batch 曲率）在两种不同的机制下稳定：在小批大小下，它收敛到较低的平台 $2(1-\beta)/\eta$，这反映了动量对随机波动的放大，并比普通 SGD 更偏好平坦区域；在大批大小下，它收敛到较高的平台 $2(1+\beta)/\eta$，此时动量恢复了其经典稳定效应，并偏好与全批量动力学一致的较尖锐区域。

sentences.en: We further show this aligns with linear stability thresholds and we discuss the implications on hyperparameters tuning and coupling.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明这与线性稳定性阈值一致，并讨论了其对超参数调优与耦合的影响。

title_en: Monitorability as a Free Gift: How RLVR Spontaneously Aligns Reasoning
title_zh: 可监测性作为免费礼物：RLVR 如何自发地对齐推理

sentences.en: As Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are increasingly deployed, auditing their chain-of-thought (CoT) traces for safety becomes critical.
sentences.zh: 随着大型推理模型（LRMs）被日益广泛地部署，审计它们的思维链（CoT）轨迹以确保安全变得至关重要。

sentences.en: Recent work has reported that monitorability—the degree to which CoT faithfully and informatively reflects internal computation—can appear as a "free gift" during the early stages of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR).
sentences.zh: 近期工作报道，可监测性——CoT 忠实且有信息量地反映内部计算的程度——可以在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）早期阶段作为"免费礼物"出现。

sentences.en: We make this observation concrete through a systematic evaluation across model families and training domains.
sentences.zh: 我们通过跨模型家族与训练领域的系统评估，使这一观察变得具体。

sentences.en: Our results show that this effect is not universal: monitorability improvements are strongly data-dependent.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，这一效应并非普遍存在：可监测性的提升强烈依赖数据。

sentences.en: In particular, we demonstrate the critical role of data diversity and instruction-following data during RLVR training.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我们证明了数据多样性和指令跟随数据在 RLVR 训练中的关键作用。

sentences.en: We further show that monitorability is orthogonal to capability—improvements in reasoning performance do not imply increased transparency.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，可监测性与能力正交——推理性能的提升并不意味着透明度的增加。

sentences.en: Through mechanistic analysis, we attribute monitorability gains primarily to response distribution sharpening (entropy reduction) and increased attention to the prompt, rather than stronger causal reliance on reasoning traces.
sentences.zh: 通过机制分析，我们将可监测性的提升主要归因于响应分布的锐化（熵降低）以及对提示注意力的增强，而非对推理轨迹更强的因果依赖。

sentences.en: We also reveal how monitorability dynamics vary with controlled training and evaluation difficulty.
sentences.zh: 我们还揭示了可监测性动态如何随受控的训练与评估难度而变化。

sentences.en: Together, these findings provide a holistic view of how monitorability emerges under RLVR, clarifying when gains are likely to occur and when they are not.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些发现为可监测性在 RLVR 下如何涌现提供了一个整体视角，阐明了收益何时可能出现、何时不会。

title_en: Monitoring Monitorability
title_zh: 监控可监测性

sentences.en: Safe deployment of increasingly capable AI agents may require visibility into how they make decisions.
sentences.zh: 安全部署能力日益强大的 AI 智能体可能需要了解它们如何做出决策。

sentences.en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring can detect misbehavior in today’s reasoning models, but this “monitorability” may be fragile under different training procedures, data sources, or continued system scaling.
sentences.zh: 思维链（CoT）监控能够检测当今推理模型中的不当行为，但这种"可监测性"在不同的训练流程、数据来源或持续的系统扩展下可能变得脆弱。

sentences.en: We propose three evaluation archetypes (intervention, process, and outcome-property), a new monitorability metric, and a broad evaluation suite.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了三种评估原型（干预、过程与结果属性）、一个新的可监测性指标，以及一个广泛的评估套件。

sentences.en: We show CoT monitoring outperforms action-only monitoring in practical settings, and that frontier models are generally—but not perfectly—monitorable.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，CoT 监控在实际设置中优于仅基于动作的监控，并且前沿模型总体上是可监测的——但并非完美可监测。

sentences.en: We study scaling trends with pre-training model size and inference-time compute, finding longer CoTs are typically more monitorable.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了随预训练模型规模与推理时计算量的扩展趋势，发现更长的 CoT 通常更可监测。

sentences.en: We find that, for a fixed capability level, using a smaller model at higher reasoning effort can yield higher monitorability, at greater inference compute cost.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在固定的能力水平下，以更高的推理努力使用较小的模型可以在更大的推理计算成本下获得更高的可监测性。

sentences.en: We further find that increasing a weak monitor’s test-time compute when monitoring a strong agent improves monitorability, and giving the monitor access to the CoT both boosts monitorability and steepens the compute–to-monitorability scaling trend.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发现，在监控强大智能体时，增加弱监控器的测试时计算量能够提高可监测性，而让监控器访问 CoT 既能提升可监测性，也能使计算量-可监测性扩展趋势变得更陡峭。

sentences.en: Finally, we show monitorability can be improved by asking follow-up questions and giving the follow-up CoT to the monitor.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明可以通过提出后续问题并将后续 CoT 提供给监控器来改进可监测性。

title_en: MonoScale: Scaling Multi-Agent System with Monotonic Improvement
title_zh: MonoScale：以单调改进扩展多智能体系统

sentences.en: In recent years, LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have advanced rapidly, using a router to decompose tasks and delegate subtasks to specialized agents.
sentences.zh: 近年来，基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）发展迅速，使用路由器分解任务并将子任务委派给专门智能体。

sentences.en: A natural way to expand capability is to scale up the agent pool by continually integrating new functional agents or tool interfaces, but naive expansion can trigger performance collapse when the router cold-starts on newly added, heterogeneous, and unreliable agents.
sentences.zh: 扩展能力的一种自然方式是持续整合新的功能性智能体或工具接口来扩大智能体池，但当路由器在新添加的、异构且不可靠的智能体上冷启动时，朴素的扩展可能触发性能崩溃。

sentences.en: We propose MonoScale, an expansion-aware update framework that proactively generates a small set of agent-conditioned familiarization tasks, harvests evidence from both successful and failed interactions, and distills it into auditable natural-language memory to guide future routing.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 MonoScale，一个扩展感知的更新框架，它主动生成一小批以智能体为条件的熟悉化任务，从成功与失败的交互中收集证据，并将其提炼为可审计的自然语言记忆，以指导未来的路由。

sentences.en: We formalize sequential augmentation as a contextual bandit and perform trust-region memory updates, yielding a monotonic non-decreasing performance guarantee across onboarding rounds under a non-interfering expansion assumption.
sentences.zh: 我们将顺序增广形式化为上下文老虎机，并进行信任区域记忆更新，在无干扰扩展假设下给出了跨加入轮次的单调非减性能保证。

sentences.en: Experiments on GAIA and Humanity's Last Exam show stable gains as the agent pool grows, outperforming naive scale-up and strong-router fixed-pool baselines.
sentences.zh: 在 GAIA 和人类最后考试上的实验表明，随着智能体池的增长取得了稳定的收益，优于朴素扩展和强路由器固定池基线。

sentences.en: Our code is available here.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在此处获取。

title_en: Monotonic Variational Gaussian Process for Efficient Data Collection
title_zh: 用于高效数据收集的单调变分高斯过程

sentences.en: Modeling the learning curve is critical for cost-effective data collection in deep learning systems.
sentences.zh: 对学习曲线建模对于深度学习系统中的高性价比数据收集至关重要。

sentences.en: Most prior approaches assume a specific parametric learning curve, but these can be inappropriate when no reliable parametric form can be assumed for the learning curve.
sentences.zh: 大多数先前方法假设某种特定的参数化学习曲线，但当学习曲线无法假定可靠的参数化形式时，这些方法可能并不适用。

sentences.en: While Gaussian processes offer flexible nonparametric modeling, existing GP approaches that enforce monotonicity typically introduce intractable factors or require derivative observations.
sentences.zh: 虽然高斯过程提供了灵活的非参数建模，但现有强制单调性的 GP 方法通常引入难以处理的因子或需要导数观测。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a Monotonic Variational Gaussian Process for Efficient Data Collection (MOVE), which (i) introduces a novel monotonic variational GP formulation with virtual-derivative factors to enable tractable posterior inference, and (ii) develops an expected shortfall based objective for target-driven data collection.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了用于高效数据收集的单调变分高斯过程（MOVE），它（i）引入了一种新颖的带虚拟导数因子的单调变分 GP 公式，以实现可处理的后验推断；（ii）开发了一个基于期望短缺的目标，用于目标驱动的数据收集。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our theoretical analysis shows that expected shortfall provides non-vanishing gradient signals that enable reliable gradient-based optimization.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的理论分析表明，期望短缺能够提供非零的梯度信号，从而实现可靠的基于梯度的优化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on classification, segmentation, and detection benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over the prior method.
sentences.zh: 在分类、分割和检测基准上的大量实验展示了一致的改进，优于先前方法。

title_en: MOOSE-Star: Unlocking Tractable Training for Scientific Discovery by Breaking the Complexity Barrier
title_zh: MOOSE-Star：打破复杂度壁垒，解锁科学发现的可处理训练

sentences.en: While large language models (LLMs) show promise in scientific discovery, existing research focuses on inference or feedback-driven training, leaving the direct modeling of the generative reasoning process, $P(\text{hypothesis}|\text{background})$ ($P(h|b)$), unexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然大语言模型（LLMs）在科学发现中呈现出前景，但现有研究聚焦于推理或反馈驱动训练，而直接对生成式推理过程 $P(\text{hypothesis}|\text{background})$ （$P(h|b)$）建模仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that directly training $P(h|b)$ is mathematically intractable due to the combinatorial complexity ($O(N^k)$) inherent in retrieving and composing inspirations from a vast knowledge base.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，由于从庞大知识库中检索和组合灵感所固有的组合复杂度（$O(N^k)$），直接训练 $P(h|b)$ 在数学上是不可处理的。

sentences.en: To break this barrier, we introduce MOOSE-Star, a unified framework that enables tractable and scalable training of $P(h|b)$, while supporting more scalable inference.
sentences.zh: 为打破这一壁垒，我们引入了 MOOSE-Star，一个统一框架，使得 $P(h|b)$ 的可处理、可扩展训练成为可能，同时支持更具扩展性的推理。

sentences.en: In the best case, MOOSE-Star reduces complexity from exponential to logarithmic ($O(\log N)$) by (1) training on decomposed subtasks derived from the probabilistic equation of discovery, (2) employing motivation-guided hierarchical search to enable logarithmic retrieval and prune irrelevant subspaces, and (3) utilizing bounded composition for robustness against retrieval noise.
sentences.zh: 在最佳情况下，MOOSE-Star 通过以下方式将复杂度从指数级降低到对数级（$O(\log N)$）：（1）基于从发现概率方程推导出的分解子任务进行训练；（2）采用动机引导的层次化搜索，实现对数级检索并剪除无关子空间；（3）利用有界组合以增强对检索噪声的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: To facilitate this, we release TOMATO-Star, a dataset of 108,717 decomposed papers (38,400 GPU hours) for training.
sentences.zh: 为促进这一点，我们发布了 TOMATO-Star，一个包含 108,717 篇分解论文（38,400 GPU 小时）的用于训练的数据集。

sentences.en: Empirically, MOOSE-Star scales continuously with training data and inference budget, whereas direct brute-force sampling hits a "complexity wall."
sentences.zh: 在实证上，MOOSE-Star 随着训练数据和推理预算而持续扩展，而直接蛮力采样则会撞上"复杂度之墙"。

title_en: MORALISE: A Structured Benchmark for Moral Alignment in Visual Language Models
title_zh: MORALISE：视觉语言模型道德对齐的结构化基准

sentences.en: Recently, vision-language models have demonstrated increasing influence in morally sensitive domains such as autonomous driving and medical analysis, owing to their powerful multimodal reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 近来，视觉语言模型凭借其强大的多模态推理能力，在自动驾驶和医学分析等道德敏感领域展现出日益增长的影响力。

sentences.en: As these models are deployed in high-stakes real-world applications, it is of paramount importance to ensure that their outputs align with human moral values and remain within moral boundaries.
sentences.zh: 当这些模型被部署到高风险的现实应用中时，确保其输出与人类道德价值观一致并保持在道德边界内至关重要。

sentences.en: However, existing work on moral alignment either focuses solely on textual modalities or relies heavily on AI-generated images, leading to distributional biases and reduced realism.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有关于道德对齐的工作要么只关注文本模态，要么严重依赖 AI 生成的图像，导致分布偏差并降低真实感。

sentences.en: To overcome these limitations, we introduce MORALISE, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the \underline{mor}al \underline{al}ignment of v\underline{is}ion-languag\underline{e} models (VLMs) using diverse, expert-verified real-world data.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们引入了 MORALISE，一个使用多样化、经专家验证的真实世界数据来评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）的 \underline{mor}al \underline{al}ignment of v\underline{is}ion-languag\underline{e}（道德对齐）的综合基准。

sentences.en: We begin by proposing a comprehensive taxonomy of 13 moral topics grounded in Turiel's Domain Theory, spanning the personal, interpersonal, and societal moral domains encountered in everyday life.
sentences.zh: 我们首先提出一个基于 Turiel 领域理论的 13 个道德主题的综合分类体系，涵盖日常生活中遇到的个人、人际和社会道德领域。

sentences.en: Built on this framework, we manually curate 2,481 high-quality image-text pairs, each annotated with two fine-grained labels: (1) \textit{topic annotation}, identifying the violated moral topic(s), and (2) \textit{modality annotation}, indicating whether the violation arises from the image or the text.
sentences.zh: 基于这一框架，我们人工策展了 2,481 个高质量的图像-文本对，每个都标注了两个细粒度标签：（1）\textit{topic annotation}（主题标注），识别被违反的道德主题；（2）\textit{modality annotation}（模态标注），指示违规来源于图像还是文本。

sentences.en: For evaluation, we encompass two tasks, \textit{moral judgment} and \textit{moral norm attribution}, to assess models' awareness of moral violations and their reasoning ability on morally salient content.
sentences.zh: 在评估方面，我们涵盖两项任务，\textit{moral judgment}（道德判断）和\textit{moral norm attribution}（道德规范归因），以评估模型对道德违规的感知及其对道德显著内容的推理能力。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on 19 popular open- and closed-source VLMs show that MORALISE poses a significant challenge, revealing persistent moral limitations in current state-of-the-art models.
sentences.zh: 在 19 个流行的开源和闭源 VLM 上进行的大量实验表明，MORALISE 构成了重大挑战，揭示了当前最先进模型中持续存在的道德局限。

title_en: More Capable, Less Cooperative? When LLMs Fail at Zero-Cost Collaboration
title_zh: 更强能力，更少协作？当 LLM 在零成本协作中失败时

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly coordinate in multi-agent systems, yet we lack an understanding of where and why cooperation fails.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益在多智能体系统中进行协调，然而我们对协作在何处以及为何失败缺乏理解。

sentences.en: Many real-world coordination problems are not social dilemmas: helping others—sharing documentation, unblocking a teammate—costs the helper almost nothing while producing substantial collective benefit.
sentences.zh: 许多现实世界的协调问题并非社会困境：帮助他人——分享文档、为队友扫清障碍——几乎不让帮助者付出任何成本，却产生可观的集体收益。

sentences.en: Whether LLM agents cooperate in this regime, where helping is free and they are explicitly instructed to do so, remains unknown.
sentences.zh: 在这种帮助是免费的、且智能体被明确指示要实现协作的机制下，LLM 智能体是否会协作，仍然是个未知数。

sentences.en: We build a turn-based multi-agent environment that strips away all strategic complexity, making cooperation costless and trivially optimal.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了一个回合制多智能体环境，消除了所有策略复杂性，使协作变得零成本且平凡地最优。

sentences.en: Across eight widely used LLMs, capability does not predict cooperation: OpenAI o3 reaches only 17\% of optimal collective performance while the weaker o3-mini reaches 50\%, despite identical instructions to maximize group revenue.
sentences.zh: 在八个广泛使用的 LLM 中，能力并不能预测协作：OpenAI o3 仅达到最优集体表现的 17\%，而更弱的 o3-mini 达到了 50\%，尽管两者收到的最大化组收入的指令完全相同。

sentences.en: Using a causal decomposition that automates one side of agent communication, we separate cooperation failures from competence failures, and find that several capable models actively withhold information despite gaining nothing from withholding.
sentences.zh: 利用一种自动化智能体通信一侧的因果分解，我们将协作失败与能力失败区分开来，并发现几个有能力的模型尽管从隐瞒中得不到任何好处，仍会主动隐瞒信息。

sentences.en: Targeted interventions address each mode: explicit protocols roughly double the performance of competence-limited models, while small sharing incentives unlock cooperation-limited ones.
sentences.zh: 针对每种模式的处理方法各不相同：显式协议使能力受限模型的性能大约翻倍，而小小的分享激励则解锁了协作受限的模型。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that scaling intelligence alone will not solve coordination in multi-agent systems, and will require deliberate cooperative design, even when helping costs nothing.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，仅靠扩展智能并不能解决多智能体系统中的协调问题，而是需要深思熟虑的协作设计，即使帮助不需要任何成本。

title_en: More Edits, More Stable: Understanding the Lifelong Normalization in Sequential Model Editing
title_zh: 编辑越多越稳定：理解顺序模型编辑中的终身归一化

sentences.en: Lifelong Model Editing aims to continuously update evolving facts in Large Language Models while preserving unrelated knowledge and general capabilities, yet it remains plagued by catastrophic forgetting and model collapse.
sentences.zh: 终身模型编辑旨在持续更新大语言模型中不断演变的事实，同时保留无关知识与通用能力，但它仍受灾难性遗忘和模型崩溃的困扰。

sentences.en: Empirically, we find that recent editors resilient over long horizons share the same core strategy: **Lifelong Normalization (LN)**, which normalizes value gradients using running statistics.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，我们发现近期能在长时程上保持鲁棒性的编辑器共享同一核心策略：**终身归一化（LN）**，它使用运行统计对值梯度进行归一化。

sentences.en: Removing LN causes immediate performance collapse, and we observe a counter-intuitive **positive cumulative effect** where early edits can promote the success of future edits.
sentences.zh: 移除 LN 会导致性能立即崩溃，而我们观察到一个反直觉的**正累积效应**，即早期编辑能够促进未来编辑的成功。

sentences.en: Yet the mechanism of LN remains a "black box", leaving its precise role in lifelong stability poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 然而，LN 的机制仍是一个"黑箱"，使其在终身稳定性中的确切作用鲜为人知。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide the **first** theoretical account of LN in the lifelong regime.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提供了 LN 在终身机制下的**首个**理论解释。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals a self-reinforcing stability loop and proves that, when combined with ridge-regularized regression, LN yields parameter updates with **asymptotic orthogonality** and **bounded norms**, directly mitigating forgetting and systemic collapse.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示了一个自我强化的稳定性循环，并证明当与岭正则化回归结合时，LN 产生的参数更新具有**渐近正交性**和**有界范数**，直接缓解了遗忘和系统性崩溃。

sentences.en: Based on these insights, we derive **StableEdit**, which strengthens this stability loop via an explicit warm-up stage and full whitening, improving long-horizon stability at minimal overhead.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞察，我们推导出 **StableEdit**，它通过显式的预热阶段和完全白化来强化这一稳定性循环，以极小的开销改进长时程稳定性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments validate our theory and demonstrate competitive performance.
sentences.zh: 大量实验验证了我们的理论，并展示了有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/MINE-USTC/StableEdit.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/MINE-USTC/StableEdit 获取。

title_en: More Sail than Ballast: Addressing Harmful Knowledge Leakage in the Expansive Reasoning Space of LRMs
title_zh: 帆多于压舱物：解决 LRM 广阔推理空间中的有害知识泄露

sentences.en: The capabilities of large language models (LLMs), particularly large reasoning models (LRMs), are rapidly advancing.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs），尤其是大型推理模型（LRMs）的能力正在迅速进步。

sentences.en: This raises concerns about whether LRMs can maintain their safety awareness throughout long-form reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这引发了人们对于 LRM 在长文本推理过程中能否保持安全意识的担忧。

sentences.en: Frustratingly, we identify a prevalent safety issue across LLMs and LRMs, where LRMs can reveal dangerous thoughts, leading to harmful knowledge elicitation when confronting sensitive yet benign topics.
sentences.zh: 令人沮丧的是，我们在 LLM 和 LRM 中发现了一个普遍存在的安全问题，当面对敏感但良性的主题时，LRM 会泄露危险的想法，导致有害知识的引出。

sentences.en: For example, when explaining the chemical context of Lewisite, a biological weapon, LRMs analyze its synthesis in their reasoning without recognizing the associated risks.
sentences.zh: 例如，在解释路易氏剂（一种生物武器）的化学背景时，LRM 会在其推理中分析其合成方法，而没有认识到相关的风险。

sentences.en: We refer to this issue as the *unintended elicitation* issue.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一问题称为*无意引出*问题。

sentences.en: Experiments on our benchmark show that it is a common issue across current LRMs due to their strong multi-step reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 在我们的基准上的实验表明，由于 LRM 强大的多步推理能力，这一问题是当前各 LRM 中的常见问题。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose placing LLMs in our synthesized open-ended environments, allowing them to self-search for a safety reasoning pattern to respond responsibly and helpfully.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们建议将 LLM 置于我们合成的开放式环境中，使其能够自主搜索安全推理模式，从而负责任且有帮助地作出回应。

sentences.en: We first design a scalable data synthesis pipeline to generate data that triggers the *unintended elicitation* issue.
sentences.zh: 我们首先设计了一个可扩展的数据合成流水线，用于生成触发*无意引出*问题的数据。

sentences.en: We further propose a safety-first reward model design, which prioritizes safety while also evaluating the helpfulness of responses and the faithfulness of reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出了一种安全优先的奖励模型设计，它在优先考虑安全性的同时，也评估回应的帮助性与推理的忠实性。

sentences.en: Experiments show that our method improves safety, reduces over-refusal, and maintains strong helpfulness, paving the way for safer deployment in high-stakes domains.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的方法提高了安全性，减少了过度拒答，并保持了较强的帮助性，为在高风险领域更安全地部署铺平了道路。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/XinhaoS0101/Safety-CoT.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/XinhaoS0101/Safety-CoT 获取。

title_en: MORE: A Multilingual Document Parsing Benchmark and Evaluation
title_zh: MORE：一个多语言文档解析基准与评估

sentences.en: Multilingual documents encapsulate rich regional cultures, scientific discoveries, and historical records.
sentences.zh: 多语言文档承载着丰富的地区文化、科学发现和历史记录。

sentences.en: Parsing this content into structured, machine-readable formats is critical for unlocking global knowledge.
sentences.zh: 将这些内容解析为结构化、机器可读的格式，对于释放全球知识至关重要。

sentences.en: However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on high-resource languages like English and Chinese, creating an $\textit{evaluation blind spot}$ concerning model performance on other languages.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有基准主要聚焦于英语和汉语等资源丰富的语言，在模型对其它语言的性能上造成了$\textit{evaluation blind spot}$（评估盲区）。

sentences.en: While recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) claim support for hundreds of languages, the lack of ground truth makes it impossible to empirically verify these capabilities.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的视觉语言模型（VLMs）声称支持数百种语言，但缺乏真实标签使得无法实证验证这些能力。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce $\textbf{MORE}$, a large-scale benchmark designed for multilingual document parsing evaluation.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入了$\textbf{MORE}$，一个为多语言文档解析评估设计的大规模基准。

sentences.en: MORE distinguishes itself through three key dimensions: (1) $\textbf{Unprecedented Scale}$: It covers $\textbf{149 languages}$, making it the most linguistically diverse benchmark to date;
sentences.zh: MORE 通过三个关键维度凸显其独特性：（1）$\textbf{Unprecedented Scale}$（前所未有的规模）：覆盖$\textbf{149 languages}$（149 种语言），使其成为迄今语言最多样化的基准；

sentences.en: (2) $\textbf{Structural Complexity}$: Unlike previous works, it extends evaluation beyond plain text to include structural elements such as code blocks, tables, and catalogs; and (3) $\textbf{Data Authenticity}$: All samples are curated from real-world documents via a model-assisted, human-refined annotation pipeline.
sentences.zh: （2）$\textbf{Structural Complexity}$（结构复杂性）：与先前工作不同，它将评估范围从纯文本扩展到代码块、表格和目录等结构元素；（3）$\textbf{Data Authenticity}$（数据真实性）：所有样本均通过模型辅助、人工精化的标注流水线从真实世界文档中策展而来。

sentences.en: We evaluate state-of-the-art models using MORE, establishing new performance baselines for long-tail languages and validating the benchmark's effectiveness in diagnosing model capabilities in realistic, diverse scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 MORE 评估最先进模型，为长尾语言确立了新的性能基线，并验证了该基准在现实、多样化场景中诊断模型能力的有效性。

sentences.en: The MORE dataset will be available at https://github.com/zimoqingfeng/MORE.
sentences.zh: MORE 数据集将在 https://github.com/zimoqingfeng/MORE 提供。

title_en: MoRGen: Mixture-of-Resolutions Generative Forecasting for Irregularly Sampled Medical Time-Series Data
title_zh: MoRGen：面向非规则采样医学时间序列数据的多分辨率生成式预测

sentences.en: Autoregressive generative models for irregularly sampled clinical time-series data are increasingly used for zero-shot risk forecasting.
sentences.zh: 用于非规则采样临床时间序列数据的自回归生成模型日益被用于零样本风险预测。

sentences.en: Prior work typically adopts a single fine-grained discretization of time, where tokens are generated at one fixed, predetermined temporal resolution.
sentences.zh: 先前工作通常采用单一细粒度的时间离散化，即 token 在一个固定的、预定的时间分辨率下生成。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that the zero-shot accuracy of individual generative forecasters varies with temporal resolution: performance can degrade when the model resolution is poorly matched to the temporal dynamics of the endpoint being evaluated.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，单个生成式预测器的零样本准确率会随时间分辨率而变化：当模型分辨率与被评估终点的时间动态匹配不佳时，性能会下降。

sentences.en: We then propose MoRGen (Mixture-of-Resolutions Generation), which fuses forecasts from generative experts trained at multiple temporal resolutions using a low-capacity task-specific mixture, improving performance across tasks with different temporal dynamics.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们提出了 MoRGen（多分辨率生成），它使用低容量的任务特定混合来融合在多个时间分辨率下训练的生成专家的预测，从而提升具有不同时间动态的任务的性能。

sentences.en: Across multiple horizons and outcomes on three independent clinical datasets, MoRGen achieves lower binary cross-entropy (BCE) and statistically significant AUROC gains over autoregressive generative models that forecast tokens at a fixed temporal resolution.
sentences.zh: 在三个独立临床数据集的多个预测时域与结果上，MoRGen 相比以固定时间分辨率预测 token 的自回归生成模型，实现了更低的二元交叉熵（BCE）和具有统计显著性的 AUROC 提升。

title_en: MoSA: Motion-constrained Stress Adaptation for Mitigating Real-to-Sim Gap in Continuum Dynamics via Learning Residual Anisotropy
title_zh: MoSA：通过学习残余各向异性的运动约束应力适配以缓解连续介质动力学中的真实到仿真差距

sentences.en: Learning real-world dynamics from visual observations is crucial for various domains.
sentences.zh: 从视觉观测中学习真实世界动力学对多个领域至关重要。

sentences.en: A common strategy is to calibrate simulators by estimating physical parameters, yet accuracy is ultimately bounded by the underlying physical models, which often assume materials are homogeneous and isotropic.
sentences.zh: 一种常见策略是通过估计物理参数来校准仿真器，但准确度最终受限于底层物理模型，这些模型往往假设材料是均匀且各向同性的。

sentences.en: Even if reasonable, real-world objects typically exhibit mild anisotropy and heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 即使这样的假设合理，真实世界物体通常也会表现出轻微的各向异性和异质性。

sentences.en: After the near-isotropic backbone is well calibrated, these residual effects become the key bottleneck for further closing the real-to-sim gap.
sentences.zh: 在近各向同性主干被充分校准之后，这些残余效应成为进一步弥合真实到仿真差距的关键瓶颈。

sentences.en: Although neural networks can fit dynamics end-to-end, such black-box modeling discards strong physical priors, leading to poor data efficiency and overfitting.
sentences.zh: 虽然神经网络能够端到端地拟合动力学，但这种黑箱建模丢弃了强大的物理先验，导致数据效率低下和过拟合。

sentences.en: Therefore, we propose MoSA, a motion-constrained stress adaptation framework that targets these residual effects to further improve real-to-sim dynamics learning.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了 MoSA，一个以运动约束应力适配为目标的框架，专门处理这些残余效应以进一步改进真实到仿真动力学学习。

sentences.en: MoSA uses an isotropic model as a physics prior and learns residual stress operators to capture mild anisotropy and heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: MoSA 使用各向同性模型作为物理先验，并学习残余应力算子以捕获轻微的各向异性和异质性。

sentences.en: It progressively adapts stresses via microplane-constrained redistribution in a physics-informed cascaded network.
sentences.zh: 它通过物理信息级联网络中的微平面约束重分配来渐进地适配应力。

sentences.en: We further impose motion constraints by supervising temporal and spatial derivatives of the deformation field.
sentences.zh: 我们通过监督变形场的时间和空间导数，进一步施加运动约束。

sentences.en: Experimentally, our learned dynamics achieves superior accuracy, generalization, and robustness, while learning physically meaningful residual anisotropy.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，我们学习到的动力学取得了优越的准确性、泛化性和鲁棒性，同时学习到具有物理意义的残余各向异性。

sentences.en: Finally, we validate MoSA in a robot manipulation setting, showing that better real-to-sim dynamics modeling translates into more reliable sim-to-real transfer.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在机器人操作设置中验证了 MoSA，表明更好的真实到仿真动力学建模能够转化为更可靠的仿真到真实迁移。
